implementation.localization: Canonical bilingual catalogues; translated interface, validation, feedback, emails, PDFs, exports, JavaScript and offline pages. Company WhatsApp notification language remains independent of the interface locale.
implementation.navigation: Five primary customer sections: dashboard, product search, requests, debts/payments and account. Existing quotation, invoice, receipt, deposit, statement, notification and help destinations remain accessible.
implementation.catalogue: Company and branch product filters, name/SKU/category search, unit/image metadata. Explicit allowlist responses exclude costs and stock records. Selling prices and unit prices are omitted when the company setting is disabled. Enabled prices use the selected branch selling location and existing LocationPriceService.
implementation.requests: Existing purchase request and quotation workflows extended with RFQ/order intent, delivery address/instructions, staff rejection and dashboard review count. Submission creates no sales or stock movements.
implementation.accounting: Existing accounting balance calculation retained, with explicit customer/company constraints. Receipt/deposit downloads now check customer ownership even when a staff session also exists.
implementation.pin: Cryptographic random four-digit PIN, hash in the existing password field, 15-minute expiry, five failed attempts, shared web/API verification and rate limits, atomic one-time consumption, short-lived setup tokens and mandatory stronger password setup. Recovery/resend rotates credentials and invalidates obsolete tokens. Permanent passwords survive unrelated edits and repeated enable operations.
implementation.onboarding: Friendly localized HARDEX WhatsApp onboarding, exact https://customer.buildcore.site/customer/login URL, encrypted queue payload, version/expiry/use checks at delivery, shared account lock preventing concurrent PIN rotation during sending, sanitized transport errors and encrypted-payload removal after delivery.
implementation.permissions: Additive grants let Cashiers review and process requests through existing branch-scoped permissions. Company price settings are restricted to the owning Admin; Super Admin/system owner can select any company.
